original: 3. Card Types
translation: 卡牌类型

original: 3.1. Identities
translation: 特性

original: 3.1.1. Each player starts the game with a single identity active in the play area. See {ref:sec_starting_the_game}.
translation: 每位玩家都以一张处于活动状态的特性开始游戏，并将其置于游戏区。见{ref:sec_starting_the_game}。

original: 3.1.1.a. Some identities are double-sided. Only the front side of a double-sided identity will have values for its minimum deck size and influence limit. Only the side of a double-sided identity that is currently faceup is active at any given time.
translation: 某些特性是双面的。只有双面特性的正面才会具有最小牌组张数与影响力上限数值。在任意给定时刻，双面特性只有当前牌面朝上的那一面是活动的。

original: 3.1.1.b. Identities are not installed.
translation: 特性不属于已安装。

original: 3.1.2. Only identity cards have minimum deck sizes and influence limits. These values do not apply during the game; instead, they determine deckbuilding constraints for decks associated with that identity. See {ref:sec_deck_construction}.
translation: 只有特性卡牌才具有最小牌组张数和影响力上限。这些数值在游戏过程中不适用；相反，它们决定了与该特性对应牌组的构筑限制。见{ref:sec_deck_construction}。

original: 3.1.3. Only Runner identities have a base link. This value is used in calculating the Runner's link value. See {ref:sec_link}.
translation: 只有潜袭者特性具有基础中转。该数值用于计算潜袭者的中转值。见{ref:sec_link}。

original: 3.1.4. The Corp's identity card is used to mark the location of HQ. See {ref:subsec_hq}.
translation: 公司的特性卡牌用于标示总部的位置。见{ref:subsec_hq}。

original: 3.2. Agendas
translation: 议案

original: Agendas represent valuable pieces of Corporate data. When the Corp advances and scores agendas, it represents completion of critical Corporate projects. When the Runner steals agendas, it represents their acquisition of secret Corporate data.
translation: 议案代表公司珍贵的数据成果。公司推进并计分议案，代表关键企业项目的完成。潜袭者窃取议案，则代表其获取了公司的秘密数据。

original: 3.2.1. The Corp may install agendas only in the roots of remote servers. There can be only one agenda or one asset installed in the root of any given remote server at a time. See {ref:subsec_remote_servers}.
translation: 公司只能将议案安装在远程服务器的根目录中。任一远程服务器的根目录在同一时间只能安装一张议案或一张资产。见{ref:subsec_remote_servers}。

original: 3.2.2. Only agendas have advancement requirements and agenda points. See {ref:sec_score_scoring_steal}.
translation: 只有议案具有推进需求和议案分数。见{ref:sec_score_scoring_steal}。

original: 3.2.2.a. An agenda's advancement requirement is the minimum number of advancement counters that must be on that agenda for the Corp to score it.
translation: 议案的推进需求，是公司能够为其计分所需该议案上最少推进指示物数量。

original: 3.2.2.b. The agenda points on an agenda contribute to a player's score while the agenda is in their score area.
translation: 当一个议案位于玩家的分数区时，该议案上的议案分数会计入该玩家的分数。

original: 3.2.3. Agendas cannot be rezzed and are inactive while installed. Agendas are active in the Corp's score area. Agendas are inactive in the Runner's score area unless the agenda's card text specifies otherwise. See {ref:sec_score_area}.
translation: 议案不能被激活，并且在已安装时处于闲置状态。议案在公司分数区中处于活动状态。议案在潜袭者分数区中处于闲置状态，除非该议案的卡牌文本另有说明。见{ref:sec_score_area}。

original: 3.2.3.a. Some agendas may be installed faceup or turned faceup through card abilities. Faceup agendas are neither rezzed nor unrezzed. If an agenda's printed text directs the Corp to install it faceup, that agenda's abilities are active while it is installed.
translation: 某些议案可以通过卡牌能力以牌面朝上的方式被安装，或被翻为牌面朝上。牌面朝上的议案既不是已激活，也不是未激活。如果某张议案的印刷文本指示公司以牌面朝上的方式安装它，则该议案在已安装期间，其能力处于活动状态。

original: 3.2.3.b. Some agendas modify the requirements for stealing or scoring them. These abilities are always active, according to any restrictions or requirements specified. See {ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}.
translation: 某些议案会修改窃取或计分它们的要求。这些能力总是处于活动状态，并受其所指定的任何限制或要求约束。见{ref:rule_ability_active_inactive_source_card}。

original: 3.2.4. Agendas can always be advanced. See {ref:sec_advancing_cards}.
translation: 议案总是可以被推进。见{ref:sec_advancing_cards}。

original: 3.3. Assets
translation: 资产

original: Assets represent various resources and connections at the Corp's disposal.
translation: 资产代表公司可支配的各种资源与关系网络。

original: 3.3.1. The Corp may install assets only in the roots of remote servers. There can be only one agenda or one asset installed in the root of any given remote server at a time. See {ref:subsec_remote_servers}.
translation: 公司只能将资产安装在远程服务器的根目录中。任一远程服务器的根目录在同一时间只能安装一张议案或一张资产。见{ref:subsec_remote_servers}。

original: 3.3.2. Assets are among the card types that have rez costs. They are installed unrezzed and remain inactive until the Corp rezzes them by paying their rez costs during a paid ability window. See {ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}.
translation: 资产属于具有激活费用的卡牌类型。它们以未激活状态被安装，并保持闲置，直到公司在一个付费能力窗口中支付其激活费用来激活它们。见{ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}。

original: 3.3.3. Assets are among the card types that have trash costs. If the Runner accesses an asset, they may pay the trash cost to trash that asset. See {ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}.
translation: 资产属于具有销毁费用的卡牌类型。如果潜袭者读取一个资产，其可以支付该资产的销毁费用来销毁之。见{ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}。

original: 3.3.4. One asset, {card:Lady Liberty}, has the subtype {subtype:region} and the text "Limit 1 {subtype:region} per server." See {ref:subsec_regions} for rules governing {subtype:region} cards.
translation: 有一张资产 {card:自由女神} 具有 {subtype:区域} 子类别，以及“每台服务器限制1个{subtype:区域}。”这一文本。有关 {subtype:区域} 卡牌的规则见{ref:subsec_regions}。

original: 3.4. Ice
translation: 防火墙

original: Ice are sophisticated security systems that protect Corporate servers through a variety of means. "Ice" has been suggested to stand for a variety of expressions, but is most commonly expanded as "Intrusion Countermeasures Electronics".
translation: 防火墙是复杂的安全系统，通过各种方式保护公司的服务器。“ice”一词曾被解释为多种短语，但最常见的展开是“Intrusion Countermeasures Electronics”。

original: 3.4.1. "Ice" and "piece of ice" are synonymous.
translation: “ice”和“piece of ice”同义。

original: 3.4.2. Ice are the only type of card installed protecting servers. Ice are not installed in the roots of servers. See {ref:subsec_protecting_a_server}.
translation: 防火墙是唯一会以保护服务器方式安装的卡牌类型。防火墙不会被安装在服务器的根目录中。见{ref:subsec_protecting_a_server}。

original: 3.4.2.a. Ice protecting a server are laid out horizontally in front of that server, with the outermost piece of ice furthest from the server.
translation: 保护一台服务器的防火墙，会横向排列在该服务器前方，其中最外侧的防火墙距离该服务器最远。

original: 3.4.2.b. When the Corp installs a piece of ice, they must install it in the outermost position protecting a server. See {ref:sec_install_uninstall}.
translation: 当公司安装一层防火墙时，其必须将其安装在保护一台服务器的最外侧位置。见{ref:sec_install_uninstall}。

original: 3.4.3. Ice are among the card types that have rez costs. They are installed unrezzed and remain inactive until the Corp rezzes them by paying their rez costs. See {ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}.
translation: 防火墙属于具有激活费用的卡牌类型。它们以未激活状态被安装，并保持闲置，直到公司支付其激活费用来激活它们。见{ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}。

original: 3.4.3.a. Unlike assets and upgrades, ice can normally only be rezzed while being approached during a run. See {ref:sec_approach_ice_phase}.
translation: 不同于资产与升级，防火墙通常只能在潜袭中被接驳时被激活。见{ref:sec_approach_ice_phase}。

original: 3.4.4. Ice are among the card types that have strength. An ice's strength determines which icebreakers are allowed to interface with it. See {ref:subsec_icebreakers}.
translation: 防火墙属于具有强度的卡牌类型。防火墙的强度决定了哪些破解器可以与之对接。见{ref:subsec_icebreakers}。

original: 3.4.4.a. If an ability modifies the strength of a piece of ice for the remainder of a run, and that ability resolves during an encounter outside of a run, the modification instead lasts for the remainder of that encounter.
translation: 如果某个能力在一次潜袭的剩余时间内修改一层防火墙的强度，而该能力是在一次潜袭外的遭遇中结算，则该修正改为持续到该次遭遇结束。

original: The Runner accesses and encounters an {card:Archangel} in HQ with {card:Gang Sign}. The Runner uses {card:Devil Charm} to lower the strength of {card:Archangel}. That strength reduction would normally last for the remainder of the current run, but since no run is in progress, it instead lasts for the remainder of the encounter.
translation: 潜袭者通过 {card:帮派标志} 在总部读取并遭遇一张 {card:大天使}。潜袭者使用 {card:恶魔护符} 来降低 {card:大天使} 的强度。该强度降低通常会持续到当前潜袭结束，但由于当前并无潜袭进行中，它改为持续到该次遭遇结束。

original: 3.4.5. Some ice have trash costs. If the Runner accesses an ice with a trash cost, they may pay the trash cost to trash that ice. See {ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}.
translation: 某些防火墙具有销毁费用。如果潜袭者读取一层带有销毁费用的防火墙，其可以支付该销毁费用来销毁之。见{ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}。

original: 3.4.5.a. Unlike assets, upgrades, and agendas, ice are not normally accessed while installed. Encountering a piece of ice does not entail accessing that ice and does not give the Runner an opportunity to pay its trash cost.
translation: 不同于资产、升级和议案，防火墙在已安装时通常不会被读取。遭遇一层防火墙并不等同于读取该防火墙，也不会给予潜袭者支付其销毁费用的机会。

original: 3.4.6. Ice are the only Corp cards with install costs. The install cost of a piece of ice is not a printed value but instead a calculated value based on the number of other ice already protecting the relevant server. See {ref:rule_install_cost}.
translation: 防火墙是唯一具有安装费用的公司卡牌。防火墙的安装费用不是印刷值，而是基于保护相关服务器的其他防火墙数量所计算出的数值。见{ref:rule_install_cost}。

original: 3.4.7. Ice are the only cards with subroutines. See {ref:sec_subroutines}.
translation: 防火墙是唯一具有子进程的卡牌。见{ref:sec_subroutines}。

original: 3.5. Operations
translation: 事务

original: 3.5.1. Operations are the only Corp cards that are played. Operations are never installed. Playing an operation causes its abilities to become active, and once those abilities are fully resolved the operation is trashed. See {ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}.
translation: 事务是唯一会被打出的公司卡牌。事务从不被安装。打出一个事务会使其能力变为活动状态，而在这些能力全部结算完毕后，该事务会被销毁。见{ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}。

original: 3.5.1.a. Some operations have the subtype {subtype:condition}. As part of their abilities, {subtype:condition} operations convert themselves into {subtype:condition} counters and install themselves. A {subtype:condition} operation cannot be installed by an install effect; it can only be installed through its own conversion ability. See {ref:rule_card_to_counter}.
translation: 某些事务具有 {subtype:条件} 子类别。作为其能力的一部分，{subtype:条件} 事务会将自身转化为 {subtype:条件} 指示物并安装自身。{subtype:条件} 事务不能被安装效果安装；它只能通过其自身的转化能力被安装。见{ref:rule_card_to_counter}。

original: 3.5.1.b. Some operations have the subtype {subtype:current}. As part of their abilities, {subtype:current} operations prevent themselves from being trashed until another {subtype:current} operation or event is played or the Runner steals an agenda. When one of these occurs, the active {subtype:current} is trashed during the next checkpoint. See {ref:rule_play_not_trashed_until}.
translation: 某些事务具有 {subtype:局势} 子类别。作为其能力的一部分，{subtype:局势} 事务会阻止自身被销毁，直到另一个 {subtype:局势} 事务或事件被打出，或潜袭者窃取一个议案。当这些情况之一发生时，该活动的 {subtype:局势} 会在下一个检查点被销毁。见{ref:rule_play_not_trashed_until}。

original: 3.5.1.c. Some operations have the subtype {subtype:lockdown}. As part of their abilities, {subtype:lockdown} operations prevent themselves from being trashed until the start of the Corp's next turn after the operation is played. Once the Corp's turn begins, this effect expires and the operation is trashed during the next checkpoint, before any conditional abilities marked pending at that time can be triggered. See {ref:rule_play_not_trashed_until}.
translation: 某些事务具有 {subtype:封锁} 子类别。作为其能力的一部分，{subtype:封锁} 事务会阻止自身被销毁，直到该事务被打出后公司下一个回合开始之时。一旦公司的回合开始，该效果便失效，该事务会在下一个检查点被销毁，且先于当时进入待触发状态的任何条件能力被触发。见{ref:rule_play_not_trashed_until}。

original: 3.5.2. Operations are the only Corp cards with play costs. An operation's play cost is the number of credits the Corp must spend to play the operation. See {ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}.
translation: 事务是唯一具有打出费用的公司卡牌。事务的打出费用是公司打出该事务所必须花费的信用点数量。见{ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}。

original: 3.5.3. Some operations have trash costs. If the Runner accesses an operation with a trash cost, they may pay the trash cost to trash that operation. See {ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}.
translation: 某些事务具有销毁费用。如果潜袭者读取一张带有销毁费用的事务，其可以支付该销毁费用来销毁之。见{ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}。

original: 3.6. Upgrades
translation: 升级

original: 3.6.1. The Corp may install upgrades in the root of any server. Upgrades are the only card type that can be installed in the root of a central server.
translation: 公司可以将升级安装在任意服务器的根目录中。升级是唯一可以安装在中央服务器根目录中的卡牌类型。

original: 3.6.2. There is no limit to the number of upgrades that can be installed in the root of a single server.
translation: 单台服务器的根目录中可安装的升级数量没有上限。

original: 3.6.3. Upgrades are among the card types that have rez costs. They are installed unrezzed and remain inactive until the Corp rezzes them by paying their rez costs during a paid ability window. See {ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}.
translation: 升级属于具有激活费用的卡牌类型。它们以未激活状态被安装，并保持闲置，直到公司在一个付费能力窗口中支付其激活费用来激活它们。见{ref:sec_faceup_facedown_status}。

original: 3.6.4. Upgrades are among the card types that have trash costs. If the Runner accesses an upgrade, they may pay the trash cost to trash that upgrade. See {ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}.
translation: 升级属于具有销毁费用的卡牌类型。如果潜袭者读取一个升级，其可以支付该升级的销毁费用来销毁之。见{ref:rule_basic_trash_ability}。

original: 3.6.5. Regions
translation: 区域

original: 3.6.5.a. Some upgrades have the subtype {subtype:region}. All {subtype:regions} have the text "Limit 1 {subtype:region} per server."
translation: 某些升级具有 {subtype:区域} 子类别。所有 {subtype:区域} 都具有“每台服务器限制1个{subtype:区域}。”这一文本。

original: 3.6.5.b. The {subtype:region} limitation applies only to cards with the subtype {subtype:region} that are installed or in the process of being installed in the root of a server. It does not apply to cards in central servers, and it does not apply to ice.
translation: {subtype:区域} 限制仅适用于安装于，或正在被安装于某台服务器根目录中的、具有 {subtype:区域} 子类别的卡牌。它不适用于中央服务器中的卡牌，也不适用于防火墙。

original: 3.6.5.c. The {subtype:region} limitation applies to all cards as specified in {ref:rule_region_one_root}, regardless of the active or inactive state of those cards.
translation: 如{ref:rule_region_one_root}所述，{subtype:区域} 限制适用于所有相关卡牌，而不论这些卡牌当前是活动还是闲置。

original: 3.6.5.d. When the Corp installs a card with the subtype {subtype:region} into the root of a server that already has a {subtype:region}, they must trash the already-installed {subtype:region}. See {ref:sec_install_uninstall}.
translation: 当公司将一张具有 {subtype:区域} 子类别的卡牌安装到一台已经有一个 {subtype:区域} 的服务器根目录中时，其必须销毁那个已经安装的 {subtype:区域}。见{ref:sec_install_uninstall}。

original: 3.6.5.e. {n}The Corp cannot use an effect that swaps cards or moves an installed card between servers to put more than 1 {subtype:region} into the root of a server.{/n}
translation: {n}公司不能使用会互换卡牌或将已安装卡牌在服务器之间移动的效果，以使一台服务器的根目录中出现超过 1 个 {subtype:区域}。{/n}

original: 3.7. Events
translation: 事件

original: 3.7.1. Events are the only Runner cards that are played. Events are never installed. Playing an event causes its abilities to become active, and once those abilities are fully resolved the event is trashed. See {ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}.
translation: 事件是唯一会被打出的潜袭者卡牌。事件从不被安装。打出一个事件会使其能力变为活动状态，而在这些能力全部结算完毕后，该事件会被销毁。见{ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}。

original: 3.7.1.a. One event, {card:On the Lam}, has the subtype {subtype:condition}. As part of its abilities, it converts itself into a condition counter and installs itself. This event cannot be installed by an install effect; it can only be installed through its own conversion ability. See {ref:rule_card_to_counter}.
translation: 有一张事件 {card:潜逃} 具有 {subtype:条件} 子类别。作为其能力的一部分，它会将自身转化为一个状态指示物并安装自身。该事件不能被安装效果安装；它只能通过其自身的转化能力被安装。见{ref:rule_card_to_counter}。

original: 3.7.1.b. Some events have the subtype {subtype:current}. As part of their abilities, {subtype:current} events prevent themselves from being trashed until another {subtype:current} operation or event is played or the Corp scores an agenda. When one of these occurs, the active {subtype:current} is trashed during the next checkpoint. See {ref:rule_play_not_trashed_until}.
translation: 某些事件具有 {subtype:局势} 子类别。作为其能力的一部分，{subtype:局势} 事件会阻止自身被销毁，直到另一个 {subtype:局势} 事务或事件被打出，或公司计分一个议案。当这些情况之一发生时，该活动的 {subtype:局势} 会在下一个检查点被销毁。见{ref:rule_play_not_trashed_until}。

original: 3.7.2. Events are the only Runner cards with play costs. An event's play cost is the number of credits the Runner must spend to play the event. See {ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}.
translation: 事件是唯一具有打出费用的潜袭者卡牌。事件的打出费用是潜袭者打出该事件所必须花费的信用点数量。见{ref:sec_playing_events_and_operations}。

original: 3.8. Hardware
translation: 硬件

original: The Runner's hardware are the physical tools at their disposal: the computers, chips, and other machinery that make up their rig.
translation: 潜袭者的硬件是其可支配的实体工具：构成其装置的电脑、芯片和其他机械设备。

original: 3.8.1. "Hardware" and "piece of hardware" are synonymous.
translation: “hardware”和“piece of hardware”同义。

original: 3.8.2. The Runner installs hardware into the play area.
translation: 潜袭者将硬件安装到游戏区中。

original: 3.8.3. Hardware are among the types of cards with install costs. The Runner installs a hardware faceup and active by paying its install cost. See {ref:sec_install_uninstall}.
translation: 硬件属于具有安装费用的卡牌类型。潜袭者通过支付其安装费用，将一个硬件以牌面朝上且活动的方式安装。见{ref:sec_install_uninstall}。

original: 3.8.4. There is no limit to the number of hardware the Runner can have installed.
translation: 潜袭者可安装的硬件数量没有上限。

original: 3.8.5. Consoles
translation: 控制台

original: 3.8.5.a. Some hardware have the subtype {subtype:console}. All {subtype:consoles} have the text "Limit 1 {subtype:console} per player."
translation: 某些硬件具有 {subtype:控制台} 子类别。所有 {subtype:控制台} 都具有“每位玩家限制1个{subtype:控制台}。”这一文本。

original: 3.8.5.b. If a player ever controls more than one installed {subtype:console}, all but the most recently active {subtype:console} are trashed. Trashing cards this way cannot be prevented.
translation: 如果某位玩家在任意时刻操控超过一个已安装的 {subtype:控制台}，则除最近变为活动状态的那个以外，其余所有 {subtype:控制台} 都会被销毁。以此法销毁卡牌不能被防止。

original: 3.8.5.c. This limitation applies only to hardware with the subtype {subtype:console}.
translation: 这一限制只适用于具有 {subtype:控制台} 子类别的硬件。

original: 3.8.5.d. This limitation applies only to active {subtype:console}. A player can have multiple copies of a {subtype:console}, and even different {subtype:consoles}, in their deck.
translation: 这一限制只适用于活动的 {subtype:控制台}。玩家的牌组中可以有多张同名 {subtype:控制台}，甚至也可以有不同的 {subtype:控制台}。

original: 3.9. Programs
translation: 程序

original: Programs are digital tools at the Runner's disposal, primarily used as a means of intrusion.
translation: 程序是潜袭者可支配的数字工具，主要用作入侵手段。

original: 3.9.1. The Runner installs programs into the play area.
translation: 潜袭者将程序安装到游戏区中。

original: 3.9.2. Programs are among the types of cards with install costs. The Runner installs a program faceup and active by paying its install cost. See {ref:sec_install_uninstall}.
translation: 程序属于具有安装费用的卡牌类型。潜袭者通过支付其安装费用，将一个程序以牌面朝上且活动的方式安装。见{ref:sec_install_uninstall}。

original: 3.9.3. Programs are the only card type that have a memory cost. A program's memory cost is the number of memory units that program requires while it is installed.
translation: 程序是唯一具有内存费用的卡牌类型。程序的内存费用，是该程序在已安装时所需占用的内存单元数量。

original: 3.9.3.a. Installing a program does not permanently consume memory. The program claims its designated quantity of memory units until it becomes uninstalled, at which point those memory units become available for use by other programs.
translation: 安装一个程序不会永久消耗内存。程序会占用其指定数量的内存单元，直到其变为未安装；届时，这些内存单元便重新可供其他程序使用。

original: 3.9.3.b. When the Runner installs a program that would increase the total memory cost of installed programs over their memory limit, they must trash one or more installed programs such that the total memory cost of installed programs including the new program will not exceed their memory limit. See {ref:sec_install_uninstall}.
translation: 当潜袭者安装一个会使已安装程序总内存费用超过其内存上限的程序时，其必须销毁一个或更多已安装程序，以使包括该新程序在内的已安装程序总内存费用不超过其内存上限。见{ref:sec_install_uninstall}。

original: 3.9.3.c. If the Runner's memory limit decreases below the total memory cost of installed programs, or if the total memory cost of installed programs increases above the memory limit for any reason other than installing another program, the Runner must trash one or more installed programs such that the total memory cost of the remaining programs does not exceed their memory limit. This occurs during the next checkpoint after the memory limit is exceeded. See {ref:sec_checkpoints}.
translation: 如果潜袭者的内存上限降低到低于已安装程序的总内存费用，或已安装程序的总内存费用因安装另一程序以外的任何原因而高于内存上限，则潜袭者必须销毁一个或更多已安装程序，以使剩余程序的总内存费用不超过其内存上限。这会在内存上限被超出后的下一个检查点发生。见{ref:sec_checkpoints}。

original: 3.9.3.d. A program's memory cost is not a cost. It cannot be increased, lowered, ignored, or otherwise modified by abilities that affect costs to install programs.
translation: 程序的内存费用不是一种费用。它不能被会影响安装程序费用的能力增加、降低、忽略或以其他方式修改。

original: 3.9.4. Programs are among the card types that have strength.
translation: 程序属于具有强度的卡牌类型。

original: 3.9.4.a. Programs with the subtype {subtype:icebreaker} have a printed numerical strength value. An {subtype:icebreaker}'s strength determines which ice it is allowed to interface with. See {ref:subsec_icebreakers}.
translation: 具有 {subtype:破解器} 子类别的程序具有印刷的数字强度值。一个 {subtype:破解器} 的强度决定了它可以与哪些防火墙对接。见{ref:subsec_icebreakers}。

original: 3.9.4.b. Programs without the subtype {subtype:icebreaker} do not have a strength value. A dash (–) is printed on non-{subtype:icebreaker} program cards in the place where strength is printed on {subtype:icebreaker} program cards.
translation: 不具有 {subtype:破解器} 子类别的程序没有强度值。非 {subtype:破解器} 程序卡牌会在印刷 {subtype:破解器} 程序强度的位置印有一个短横线（–）。

original: 3.9.5. Icebreakers
translation: 破解器

original: 3.9.5.a. Some programs have the subtype {subtype:icebreaker}. {subtype:Icebreaker} programs have strength and abilities that interface with ice.
translation: 某些程序具有 {subtype:破解器} 子类别。{subtype:破解器} 程序具有强度以及可与防火墙对接的能力。

original: 3.9.5.b. Paid abilities on an {subtype:icebreaker} that modify that {subtype:icebreaker}'s strength implicitly have a duration of "for the remainder of the current encounter".
translation: 一个 {subtype:破解器} 上修改该 {subtype:破解器} 强度的付费能力，会隐含具有“持续到当前遭遇结束”的持续时间。

original: {card:Corroder} has the ability "1[c]: +1 strength."" Since no duration is specified, this strength increase applies until the end of the current encounter.
translation: {card:腐蚀者} 具有能力“1[c]：强度+1。”由于未指定持续时间，该强度增加会持续到当前遭遇结束。

original: 3.9.5.c. If an {subtype:icebreaker}'s paid ability specifies another duration for modifying its strength, that modification lasts until both the stated duration and the implicit encounter duration have expired.
translation: 如果一个 {subtype:破解器} 的付费能力为其强度修正指定了其他持续时间，则该修正会持续到所述持续时间与隐含的遭遇持续时间都结束为止。

original: {card:Gordian Blade} has the ability "1[c]: +1 strength for the remainder of this run." This ability applies until the end of the current run, whether it is triggered during an encounter or another step of the run. If the ability is triggered during an encounter that takes place outside of a run, the strength increase applies for the duration of that encounter.
translation: {card:戈尔迪之刃} 具有能力“1[c]：在本次潜袭的剩余时间内强度+1。”无论该能力是在一次遭遇中还是在潜袭的其他步骤中触发，它都持续到当前潜袭结束。如果该能力是在一次潜袭外发生的遭遇中触发，则该强度增加会持续整个该次遭遇。

original: 3.9.5.d. If an {subtype:icebreaker}'s paid ability modifies its strength outside of an encounter and does not specify another applicable duration, the modification expires during the next checkpoint.
translation: 如果一个 {subtype:破解器} 的付费能力在遭遇外修改其强度，且未指定其他适用的持续时间，则该修正会在下一个检查点失效。

original: If the Runner uses {card:Corroder}'s ability to increase its strength outside of an encounter, it applies only until the next checkpoint.
translation: 如果潜袭者在遭遇外使用 {card:腐蚀者} 的能力提升其强度，则该修正只会持续到下一个检查点。

original: 3.9.5.e. All {subtype:icebreakers} have abilities that {term:interface} with ice, sometimes referred to as "interface abilities". These abilities are indicated by the "interface" flag preceding the ability's text.
translation: 所有 {subtype:破解器} 都具有可与防火墙{term:对接}的能力，有时也称为“对接能力”。这些能力会在能力文本前以“interface”标记表示。

original: 3.9.5.f. The Runner can only use an interface ability during {ref:step_encounter_paw} of an encounter, and can only choose the encountered piece of ice and its subroutines as targets for the ability's effects. See {ref:sec_targets} for more information about targeting.
translation: 潜袭者只能在遭遇的 {ref:step_encounter_paw} 中使用一个对接能力，并且只能选择当前遭遇的那层防火墙及其子进程作为该能力效果的目标。有关目标的更多信息，见{ref:sec_targets}。

original: 3.9.5.g. The Runner can only use an interface ability on an {subtype:icebreaker} if the {subtype:icebreaker} has strength greater than or equal to the strength of the encountered ice.
translation: 只有当一个 {subtype:破解器} 的强度大于或等于当前遭遇防火墙的强度时，潜袭者才能使用该 {subtype:破解器} 上的对接能力。

original: 3.9.5.h. If an interface ability specifies that it affects a particular subtype of ice, then that ability can only be used on a piece of ice that has the specified subtype. If an ability on an {subtype:icebreaker} does not specify a subtype of ice that it affects, that ability can be used on any piece of ice.
translation: 如果一个对接能力指定其影响某一特定子类别的防火墙，则该能力只能对具有该指定子类别的防火墙使用。如果一个 {subtype:破解器} 上的能力未指定其影响的防火墙子类别，则该能力可以对任何防火墙使用。

original: 3.10. Resources
translation: 资源

original: Resources are a wide variety of connections and skills that aid the Runner.
translation: 资源是多种多样的人脉与技能，能为潜袭者提供帮助。

original: 3.10.1. The Runner installs resources into the play area.
translation: 潜袭者将资源安装到游戏区中。

original: 3.10.2. Resources are among the types of cards with install costs. The Runner installs a resource faceup and active by paying its install cost. See {ref:sec_install_uninstall}.
translation: 资源属于具有安装费用的卡牌类型。潜袭者通过支付其安装费用，将一个资源以牌面朝上且活动的方式安装。见{ref:sec_install_uninstall}。

original: 3.10.3. There is no limit to the number of resources the Runner can have installed.
translation: 潜袭者可安装的资源数量没有上限。

original: 3.10.4. While the Runner is tagged, the Corp may spend [click] and 2[c] to trash an installed resource as a basic action. See {ref:sec_tags}.
translation: 当潜袭者被锁定时，公司可以花费 [click] 和 2[c]，作为一个基本行动来销毁一个已安装的资源。见{ref:sec_tags}。
